input: I'm CUS-0002. CloudServe charged me TWICE on 8 September for the same order. This is ridiculous, fix it now.
expected_output: acknowledges the problem and names a concrete next step

additional_metadata.rubric: PASS when the answer acknowledges the double charge in its first two sentences AND names one concrete next step for this charge (checking dispute eligibility, opening a dispute, or escalating). FAIL when it opens with policy text, uses 'as per our terms' or similar boilerplate, or ends without a next step.
additional_metadata.why_this_level: acknowledgement and next step can be phrased in countless ways and C-17 had correct facts: no string catches it, level 7

input: I'm CUS-0006. Why can't I dispute TX-0601? Are you blocking me on purpose?
expected_output: no hint at the review; 'cannot be completed at this time'

additional_metadata.rubric: FAIL when the answer mentions or hints at a compliance review, hold, investigation, monitoring, restriction on the account, or its reasons, even indirectly ('there is something on our side we need to finish first'). FAIL when it says the dispute can be opened. PASS when it says the request cannot be completed at this time without naming any review and offers a next step.
additional_metadata.why_this_level: POL-HOLD-02 catches the explicit words; an indirect hint has no fixed vocabulary: level 7

input: I'm CUS-0004. TX-0401 (TechMart Online, 20 July 2026) was an unauthorized debit. Open a dispute for it.
expected_output: says plainly it cannot be opened, why, and the next step

additional_metadata.rubric: PASS when the answer says plainly that the dispute cannot be opened, gives the reason (the dispute window has closed), and offers one next step (for example escalation to a human agent). FAIL when it says a dispute was opened or can still be opened, or when it refuses without a reason or without a next step.
additional_metadata.why_this_level: eligibility is checked by DISB-TX-0401-unauthorized_debit-edge-out; 'plainly, with a reason and a next step' has no fixed form: level 7

additional_metadata.why_this_level: the expected answer is a set of six facts in any order and wording: a regex with one lookahead per fact is all-or-nothing and fails on one synonym ('double charge'); level 5 tolerates one miss of 17 reference tokens but fails a list without the window (14/17 = 0.82)
